product.title: Colosseum Tour with Arena Floor & Roman Forum | Semi-Private

description.text: In Rome, if you’re interested in ancient Roman history, take this small-group guided tour that includes access to the Colosseum’s arena floor, the Roman Forum, and Palatine Hill. Learn more from your guide than you would wandering around by yourself, and ask lots of questions, which isn’t easy on larger tours. Stops include Colosseum Arena Floor, Roman Forum, Palatine Hill. See where ancient gladiatorial battles were fought, and where governance decisions were made, at these must-visit sites. Ideal for visitors basing in Rome who want a guided city experience without coordinating Metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Colosseum Arena Floor, Roman Forum, Palatine Hill that define this Rome sightseeing experience, with a guide handling Metro connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
